title: Inactive user re-engagement
description: Win back users who have not logged in lately with a short WhatsApp message and a quick reply. Marketing template for SaaS churn.
notes: Reference concrete progress (projects saved) to make it personal. Ask a question; it beats pushing a login.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, we have not seen you in Lumen for {{days}} days. Your {{projects}} projects are still waiting. Is there anything we can help you with?
